chunks: As for what Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from ʿAli ibn Riʾab, from Abi ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
I heard him saying: Indeed, Fatihat al-Kitab alone is sufficient in the obligatory prayer.
So the proper way regarding this report is that we interpret it as applying to a state of necessity, not to a state of choice; that is indicated by what follows.

key_terms.الْخَبَرِ: the report or hadith under discussion
key_terms.تَجُوزُ: is valid or sufficient in legal application
key_terms.حَالِ الضَّرُورَةِ: a state of necessity or compulsion
key_terms.حَالِ الِاخْتِيَارِ: a state of normal choice and capacity
key_terms.فَاتِحَةَ الْكِتَابِ: the Opening of the Book, meaning Surat al-Fatihah

ai.seo_question: Is reciting only Fatihat al-Kitab sufficient in the obligatory prayer?
ai.summary: This report addresses the ruling of reciting only Fatihat al-Kitab in the obligatory prayer. It indicates that such recitation is accepted in a state of necessity, while in normal circumstances a complete surah is required along with it.
